full_judgment: 2. The facts, in brief, for disposal of the Rule are that the petitioners as the plaintiffs instituted the suit for permanent injunction against the defendants in the Court of Assistant Judge, Shahara Upazila stating, inter alia, that Abdul Majid the original owner died leaving 3 sons and 4 daughters including Jamina Khatoon who became the owner of the suit land along with other land measuring 8.12 acres of land according to legal shares. Jamina Khatoon daughter of late Abdul Majid became owner in possession of the suit land along with other land by amicable partition and while in possession Jamina Khatoon sold the suit land to the plaintiff No. 1 by kabala dated 16-5-1987 and delivered possession. The plaintiff mutated his name and got separated the Jama being khatian No.10/1 who constructed a hut on the suit land and doing cloth business therein. And his brother plaintiff No.2 also has been running the business of radio repairing and other works with the permission of the plaintiff No. 1.
